“meat of the poor”, provide micronutrients to more than 300 million people in the tropics and, in many areas, are the second
most important source of calories following maize. In South Africa, dry beans accounted for about 80% of total caloric supply
provided by pulses. Their production is key to ensuring food security in many poor regions of the world (Semba et al., 2021).
In contrast, miscellaneous beans that include winged bean (Psophocarpus tetragonolobus), lablab (Lablab purpureus), jack bean
